author: Cognito III
title: Ablation A: Deeper Refinement (1024x60 -> 16x1760)
abstract: This is Ablation Study A on the adaptive search algorithm. The hypothesis is that a more selective and deeper refinement stage is beneficial. The number of elite candidates for Stage 2 is halved (from 32 to 16), and the refinement iterations for each are doubled (from 880 to 1760), keeping the total computational budget constant.
